item.title: Blog2RSS
item.description: Blog2RSS is an extension to MediaWiki, that requires Semantic MediaWiki. It allows to use Semantic MediaWiki’s query mechanism to create RSS feeds. As of 27 December 2007, Blog2RSS is yet unpublished. I need to change that soon :) Write me and poke me to speed that up.

item.title: Philosophische Grundlagen
item.description: I had a talk on Philosophical Foundations of Ontologies last week at the AIFB. I prepared it in German (and thus, all the slides were in German) and just before I started I got asked if I may give the talk in English. Having never heard a single lesson in philosophy in English and having read English philosophy only on Wikipedia before, I said yes. Nevertheless, the talk was very well perceived, and so I decided to upload it.

item.title: Simia technology
item.description: Simia is run on MediaWiki with the Semantic MediaWiki and Blog2RSS extension enabled. I plan to describe here more details of the technology and what it allows to do, and how it can be used on your own webspace, but for now I just point to a number of nice pages to demonstrate some of the possibilities: A timeline view of all posts that have been published on the Nodix blog A timeline view of all comments to the blogs here A list of all blog posts – alphabetically A list of a few feeds created on this page – creating new feeds is easy An example of a page with a number of comments In good web tradition you can view the source of any page (and I don’t mean the HTML source, which your browser allows you to view anyway, I mean the wiki source of the page): just go to the bottom of the page and click on the view source link.
